data.title: Nvidia and 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks Backed by Hyperscaler Data Center Spending
data.description: AI data centers are turning into the new industrial parks of the digital economy, and capital is rushing to power them. Nvidia and Broadcom are already seeing triple digit data center and AI chip revenue gains, which shows how quickly money is moving toward this build out. In this article you will see three large cap cloud and internet platforms that are tied to this same wave, and why their exposure to this theme matters for your portfolio decisions.
